description: Changes a collection: settings (name, singular, plural, urlFolder, which moves the item pages with their route, the links to them and redirects for published ones, reservedSlugs, sort, manualOrder, groups, translatable and translatedOnly for the site's languages), collection page settings (page: SEO title and description templates with {field} tokens, Open Graph, canonical, noindex, JSON-LD, custom code) and fields: add, update (label, required, help, options, reference target, validation, default, translatable), rename (moves the key in every item, the page settings and code bindings of files that name the collection, in one reviewable change), reorder (every id) and delete (refused when items hold values unless allowDataLoss: ask the user first). dryRun counts what rename and delete would touch. Parts run in that order; each part that fails is listed and the rest still apply. Writes go to the branch the workspace has open, the same as the Content tab. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. Works on every plan within its collection and item limits (Free: 2 collections and 100 items a site); turning a folder into a Xodia collection needs a paid plan.

allowDataLoss.description: Deleting a field that items have values in is refused unless this is true. Ask the user first

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

collection.description: The collection id (its folder under content/), from list_collections

dryRun.description: Only count what rename and delete would change; writes nothing

collection.description: reference and multiReference: the target collection id

help.description: One line shown under the input

id.description: Optional: the key in items and code (camelCase); default from the label

label.description: The field's name as the owner sees it

options.description: option fields: [{"id": "news", "label": "News"}]; items store the id

position.description: Index to insert at; default the end

type.description: One of plainText, richText, image, multiImage, videoLink, link, email, phone, number, date, dateTime, switch, color, option, file, reference, multiReference

validation.description: minLength, maxLength, min, max, pattern, fileTypes

delete.description: Field ids to delete (their values leave every item)

rename.description: Moves the key in every item, in page settings and in code bindings (data-field, data-show-if, item.<id>) of files that name the collection

reorder.description: Every field id in the new order

translatable.description: Translatable collections: true gives this field a value per language, false makes it the same in every language, null goes back to its type's default (text and image descriptions translate)

page.description: Collection page settings: titleTag and metaDescription templates with {field} tokens ("{title} | Blog", "{summary}"; system tokens slug, createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt, "|date" formats a date), ogTitle and ogDescription ("sameAsSeo" or a template), ogImageField (an image field id), canonical, noindex (true or a switch field id), jsonLd {preset: article, product, event, jobPosting or custom, template}, customCode {head, bodyEnd} with tokens (values HTML-escaped). Replaces the whole page object; null clears it

manualOrder.description: Items keep a manual order (drag in the Content tab, order on update_item)

redirect.description: With a new urlFolder: omit for redirects only when the collection was published; true always; false never

reservedSlugs.description: Slugs at the item level kept for static pages or folders beside the items ("archive" lets a page sit at /blog/archive); items can't use them. null clears

sort.description: Default order of lists: {"field": "publishedAt", "dir": "desc"}; null for newest first

translatable.description: Items get translations in the site's other languages (doc 46): text and image description fields translate by default; turning it off keeps the translation files unused. Only when the user asks

translatedOnly.description: Collection lists in other languages show only items translated and published in that language

urlFolder.description: Moves the item pages to /<urlFolder>/<slug> ("resources/blog" puts them in the resources folder): the route, internal links to items, and redirects from the old addresses when the collection was published

name: update_collection
title: Update a CMS collection
